mapper.sql: id, document_num, enterprise_num, seller_tax_code, invoice_point_code, invoice_type, payer, client_industry, document_date, contract_status, tax_amount, tax_rate, no_tax_amount, tax_value, is_first_invoice, is_rent_pay_full, is_hold_invoice, purchaser_tax_code, purchaser_name, purchaser_dress, purchaser_tel, purchaser_bank_name, purchaser_bank_num, plan_repay_date, period_num, product_code, product_name, unit, quantity, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, contract_code, source_from, account_name, is_auto_generation, main_category, voucher_id, mapping_category, system_invoice_id, seller_name, business_source, comments, back_tax_amount, back_tax_value, invoice_number, error_message, org_id, process_status, manual_id
mapper.update: with other_res as ( select * from eg_invoice_claim where source_from != '2' ) ,mq_res as ( select * from eg_invoice_claim where source_from = '2' ) ,except_res as ( select id from mq_res where invoice_type in ('数电专票','数电普票','008','009')--发票类型为 数电专票 或 数电普票 或 008 或 009， and coalesce(tax_amount,0) > 0 and exists (select 1 from other_res where coalesce(mq_res.invoice_number,'') = coalesce(other_res.invoice_number,'')) union select id from mq_res where invoice_type not in ('数电专票','数电普票','008','009','收据','222')--发票类型不为 数电专票、数电普票、收据、008、009、222， and coalesce(tax_amount,0) > 0 and exists (select 1 from other_res where coalesce(mq_res.invoice_number,'') = coalesce(other_res.invoice_number,'') and coalesce(mq_res.invoice_point_code,'') = coalesce(other_res.invoice_point_code,'')) )update eg_invoice_claim set del_flag = '1' where id in (select id from except_res) and del_flag = '0'

with other_res as ( select distinct invoice_number, invoice_point_code, contract_code from eg_invoice_claim where source_from != '2' )update eg_invoice_claim set contract_code = other_res.contract_code from other_res where coalesce(eg_invoice_claim.invoice_number,'') = coalesce(other_res.invoice_number,'') and coalesce(eg_invoice_claim.invoice_point_code,'') = coalesce(other_res.invoice_point_code,'') and other_res.contract_code is not null and eg_invoice_claim.contract_code is null and eg_invoice_claim.source_from != '2'
mapper.select:
select eic.document_num, eic.enterprise_num, eic.seller_tax_code, eic.invoice_point_code, eic.payer, eic.client_industry, eic.document_date, eic.contract_status, eic.tax_amount, eic.tax_rate, eic.no_tax_amount, eic.tax_value, eic.is_first_invoice, eic.is_rent_pay_full, eic.is_hold_invoice, eic.is_rent_pay_full, eic.is_hold_invoice, eic.purchaser_tax_code, eic.purchaser_name, eic.purchaser_dress, eic.purchaser_tel, eic.purchaser_bank_name, eic.purchaser_bank_num, case when eic.product_name = '罚息' then erp.actual_repayment_date when eic.product_name = '租金' then erp.actual_repayment_date else eic.plan_repay_date end as plan_repay_date, case when eic.product_name = '租金' then eic.period_num else '' end as period_num, eic.product_code, eic.product_name, eic.unit, eic.quantity, eic.contract_code, eic.seller_name, eic.comments, ec.contract_name, ec.lease_type, ec.org_id, ec.client_name, erp.plan_date, case when eic.product_name = '租金' then erp.principal_amount else null end as principal_amount, case when eic.product_name = '租金' then erp.interest_amount else null end as interest_amount, ec.invoice_type, (coalesce(erp.principal_amount) + coalesce(erp.interest_amount)) as rentReceivableAmount, ec.system_code, etr.tax_rate as backTaxRate from eg_invoice_claim eic left join eg_repayment_plan erp on eic.contract_code = erp.contract_code and eic.period_num = cast(coalesce(erp.periods,0) as char) and erp.del_flag ='0' left join eg_contract ec on eic.contract_code = ec.contract_code and ec.del_flag ='0' inner join eg_tax_rate etr on ec.lease_type = etr.lease_type and etr.del_flag ='0' and etr.enable_flag ='1' and etr.fund_type='tax_general' where 1 = 1 and eic.del_flag ='0'
and eic.contract_code = #{param.contractCode}::text
and ec.org_id = #{param.orgId}::text
union select '', '', '', '', easd.real_invoice_org_object , '', null, '', easd.real_accrual_amount, easd.real_accrual_rate ::text, 0, easd.real_accrual_tax_amount , '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', easd.billing_date , easd.period_num , '', easd.accrual_name , '', '', easd.contract_code , easd.real_invoice_org_id , '', easd.contract_name , easd.business_code , easd.invoice_org_id, easd.invoice_org_object, easd.receivable_date , easd.receivable_principal , easd.receivable_intrest , easd.pre_invoice_type , easd.receivable_other , '', easd.accrual_rate from eg_accrual_situation_data easd where 1=1
and easd.contract_code = #{param.contractCode}::text
and easd.invoice_org_id = #{param.orgId}::text

select * from (select t.md5, count(1) duplicate_count, string_agg(t.id::text, ', ') AS ids from (select id, md5(mq_data::text) md5 from eg_invoice_claim where del_flag = '0' and mq_data != '' and mq_data is not null and create_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '10 days') t group by t.md5) t1 where t1.duplicate_count > 1
